item.title: Prompt Injection: Hijack LLM Instructions
item.description: I started a Hack The Box AI security lab with zero expectations. Three minutes later, I had leaked a secret key the model had been explicitly told never to reveal. Here’s what I learned — and why it matters if you build with LLMs.
